metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Bram Brushmark
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Bram Brushmark is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as astonished shoulder-graze survivor and lists one broad clean pad taped over shoulder lobe, a small torn sleeve flap as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That went past my ear.

records.name: Vera Quickpress
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Vera Quickpress is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as determined upper-lobe graze survivor and lists round absorbent pad held firmly against a top lobe as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Keep the dressing steady.

records.name: Hugo Wrapcheck
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Hugo Wrapcheck is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as grumpy torso-graze survivor and lists thick diagonal wrap around belly and torn fabric edge as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I only just patched that.

records.name: Ivy Pocketstop
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Ivy Pocketstop is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as relieved impact survivor and lists small rounded tin in one hand with a single clear shallow dent, wrapped lower lobe as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That tin used to hold mints.

records.name: Perry Sidegraze
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Perry Sidegraze is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as frightened cheek-graze survivor and lists one wide adhesive dressing along cheek, entirely clear of eye as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Please say it missed.

records.name: Cal Stiffarm
records.biography_en: When the HyperNorm responders arrive, Cal Stiffarm is among the injured residents. The scene card identifies the character as weary forearm-graze survivor and lists clean bulky dressing around a short goo arm resting in loose sling as the visual cue.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Can someone else hold the bag?
